extra.final_summary: Found and fixed several data issues affecting the total body mass by species. First, island names had case and space variants (e.g., 'torgersen', 'Dream ') which were normalized to the allowed values. Second, body_mass_g was stored as text with commas; it was converted to numeric. Third, three penguins had negative flipper lengths (e.g., -215 mm), which are impossible, so those rows were excluded. Finally, one penguin had a body mass of 3,550,000 grams (3.55 metric tons), which is impossible for a penguin and far outside the 2500-6500g range, so that row was also excluded. After these fixes, the analysis ran on 60 valid rows. The total body mass is 117,250 grams for Adelie, 55,625 grams for Chinstrap, and 70,175 grams for Gentoo penguins.
